summary: Tested SPILIVERE backend (commission distribution + team endpoints + non-regression) and frontend (team-direct + team-details). Commission logic (N-hops via sponsor chain, skip-if-unqualified, 50/50 spillover split) verified by local script (3/3 PASS). 17/17 pytest API tests pass against live preview backend. Frontend renders new binary tree UI on /team-direct and N1..N12 matrix-depth tabs on /team-details, correctly calling /api/team/level?level=N (no legacy /team/details calls).

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 400 (custom HTTPException) instead of 422 (FastAPI validation). Functional — clients receive a clear error — but inconsistent with FastAPI conventions. Consider using Query(..., ge=1, le=12) for 422 validation.

issues: Capacity labels like '1.024k' may be confusing — '1.024k' looks like 1.024 (European decimal). Consider '1k'/'1.0k'/'1 024' (with FR space separator) for clarity, especially since exact thresholds are 1024/2048/4096.

action_items: (Optional) Use Query(..., ge=1, le=12) on /api/team/level to standardize 422 validation responses.
(Optional) Improve capacity label formatting on team-details N10/N11/N12 tabs ('1.024k' is ambiguous in FR locale).

End-to-end commission test on prod was not run (admin max_level=2 limits L3+ distribution testing in prod). Distribution logic is covered by isolated DB test, but a full e2e activation+payout cycle in staging would strengthen confidence.
critical_code_review_comments: matrix.py distribute_commission walks sponsor chain N hops correctly and supports 50/50 spillover split — logic is clean and well-isolated. Local DB tests cover the 3 main scenarios.
server.py team_level uses BFS over matrix_links collection and excludes _id; payload schema is consistent (id, username, status, max_level, is_spillover, leg, sponsor_username).
server.py team_tree uses recursive traversal with max_depth guard — looks safe for 12-level matrix; consider memoization if used at scale but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both pages render with expected copy, controls, and correct API calls)

After login the app redirects to /. Pages tested: /team-direct (binary tree visual, depth selector 2/3/4) and /team-details (tabs N1..N12 calling /api/team/level?level=N). Admin has no children in prod so both pages show empty states which is the expected/correct UX. test_api_team_endpoints.py is a reusable regression suite for next iterations.
